beats.covered_when: The first 1.5s carry a concrete claim. A greeting, a name, or a company intro does not count.
Names who suffers and what the pain is. A market category is not a problem.
Describes the mechanism — how it works. Adjectives about the product do not count.
Visual material of the product exists in the footage. A talking head describing the product does not count.
At least one spoken number with a time reference.
Names people and their unfair advantage.
A call to action with an object — what the viewer should do, and with what.
